codeReview.description: -1 for something that must change before it lands, 1 if it looks good, 0 for no vote.

comments.description: Inline comments on the patch set's files, at most 100.

path.description: The file's path in the repository.

line.description: The line in the patch set's version of the file, or null for a comment on the whole file.

message.description: The comment, in Markdown, at most 8,000 characters.
